name: Rhys ap Gruffydd
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing himself, but through a deep fascination with the engineering complexities of rally cars during his upbringing in rural Wales. This led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. Post-graduation, he cut his teeth at a small racing outfit, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and knack for problem-solving. 

His approach as a Technical Director is heavily data-driven, emphasizing meticulous preparation and a relentless pursuit of incremental improvements. He believes in empowering his team to take ownership of their respective areas while maintaining a high standard of accountability. Rhys is known for his ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies, enabling drivers and engineers alike to optimize performance. What sets him apart is his ability to maintain composure under intense pressure, a trait honed through years of troubleshooting car failures on race day, making him a calming but demanding influence in the garage.

Rhys joined JOTA Sport three years ago, and is keen to establish them as a dominant racing force for years to come.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Rhys has a serious, focused demeanor, conveyed through his sharp eyes and concentrated expression.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out engineering handbook with him, despite having the same information digitally.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, driving some colleagues crazy.
Insists on starting every race weekend with a traditional Welsh breakfast, regardless of location.
